title: Tensor action and counit equations for a unit-defined left-adjoint projection
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category], with associators $\alpha^{\mathcal C},\alpha^{\mathcal D}$. Let $J:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be left adjoint to $Q:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, with specified natural Hom bijections, unit $v:1\to QJ$ and counit $e:JQ\to1$ [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Suppose $Q$ is strong monoidal [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], and write its inverse tensor comparison as $\mu_{F,N}:Q(F\otimes N)\xrightarrow{\sim}QF\otimes QN$.
For arbitrary $M\in\mathcal C$ and $N\in\mathcal D$, let $\kappa_{M,N}:J(M\otimes QN)\to JM\otimes N$ be the unique map whose $J\dashv Q$ transpose is
$$b_{M,N}=\mu_{JM,N}^{-1}\circ(v_M\otimes1_{QN}):M\otimes QN\longrightarrow Q(JM\otimes N).$$
Then $\kappa$ is natural in both arguments and for all $M,N_1,N_2$,
$$
(\kappa_{M,N_1}\otimes1_{N_2})\circ\kappa_{M\otimes QN_1,N_2}
=(\alpha^{\mathcal D}_{JM,N_1,N_2})^{-1}\circ\kappa_{M,N_1\otimes N_2}\circ J\bigl((1_M\otimes\mu_{N_1,N_2}^{-1})\circ\alpha^{\mathcal C}_{M,QN_1,QN_2}\bigr).
$$
Both sides go from $J((M\otimes QN_1)\otimes QN_2)$ to $(JM\otimes N_1)\otimes N_2$. For arbitrary $F,N\in\mathcal D$ one also has
$$
e_{F\otimes N}\circ J(\mu_{F,N}^{-1})=(e_F\otimes1_N)\circ\kappa_{QF,N}:J(QF\otimes QN)\longrightarrow F\otimes N.
$$
No invertibility of $\kappa$, full faithfulness of $J$, symmetry, closedness, or exactness is assumed.

proof.text:
Write $m_{F,N}=\mu_{F,N}^{-1}:QF\otimes QN\to Q(F\otimes N)$. Thus $m$ is the forward tensorator of $Q$ in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. Write $T_{X,Y}$ for the specified Hom bijection of $J\dashv Q$. By [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], $T(a)=Q(a)\circ v_X$, $T^{-1}(b)=e_Y\circ J(b)$, and $T$ is injective and natural in both variables. In particular the specified map exists uniquely and satisfies
$$Q(\kappa_{M,N})\circ v_{M\otimes QN}=m_{JM,N}\circ(v_M\otimes1_{QN}).$$
These are direct substitutions into the cited bijection; no invertibility of $\kappa$ is used.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
For morphisms $a:M\to M'$ and $h:N\to N'$, transpose the proposed naturality equation. Naturality of $m$ and of $v$ gives
$$T\bigl((J(a)\otimes h)\circ\kappa_{M,N}\bigr)
=Q(J(a)\otimes h)\circ m_{JM,N}\circ(v_M\otimes1)
=m_{JM',N'}\circ(v_{M'}\otimes1)\circ(a\otimes Q(h))
=T\bigl(\kappa_{M',N'}\circ J(a\otimes Q(h))\bigr).$$
Injectivity of $T$ proves naturality in both arguments. The middle equality uses exactly the tensorator naturality in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor] and $QJ(a)\circ v_M=v_{M'}\circ a$ from [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]; tensor bifunctoriality is [def-sfb-monoidal-category].

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
For the tensor-action equation put $X=(M\otimes QN_1)\otimes QN_2$ and $Y=(JM\otimes N_1)\otimes N_2$, and call its left side $L$. Postcomposition naturality of $T$, the defining transpose in Step 1, and tensorator naturality give
$$\begin{aligned}
T_{X,Y}(L)&=Q(\kappa_{M,N_1}\otimes1)\circ m_{J(M\otimes QN_1),N_2}\circ(v_{M\otimes QN_1}\otimes1)\\
&=m_{JM\otimes N_1,N_2}\circ((Q(\kappa_{M,N_1})\circ v_{M\otimes QN_1})\otimes1)\\
&=m_{JM\otimes N_1,N_2}\circ(m_{JM,N_1}\otimes1)\circ((v_M\otimes1)\otimes1).
\end{aligned}$$
Only the two indicated naturality substitutions and tensor bifunctoriality are involved.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
Call the right side of the tensor-action equation $R$, with the same $X,Y$ as in Step 3. Put $c=(1_M\otimes m_{N_1,N_2})\circ\alpha^{\mathcal C}_{M,QN_1,QN_2}:X\to M\otimes Q(N_1\otimes N_2)$. Pre- and postcomposition naturality of $T$ and Step 1 give
$$T_{X,Y}(R)=Q((\alpha^{\mathcal D}_{JM,N_1,N_2})^{-1})\circ m_{JM,N_1\otimes N_2}\circ(v_M\otimes1)\circ c.$$
By tensor bifunctoriality and naturality of the associator, the final two factors expand as
$$(v_M\otimes1)\circ c
=(1_{QJM}\otimes m_{N_1,N_2})\circ\alpha^{\mathcal C}_{QJM,QN_1,QN_2}\circ((v_M\otimes1)\otimes1).$$
All identities here are naturality in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] or the defining bifunctor/associator naturality in [def-sfb-monoidal-category].

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
The associativity axiom for the strong monoidal functor $Q$ in [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], applied to $(JM,N_1,N_2)$, is exactly
$$Q(\alpha^{\mathcal D}_{JM,N_1,N_2})\circ m_{JM\otimes N_1,N_2}\circ(m_{JM,N_1}\otimes1)
=m_{JM,N_1\otimes N_2}\circ(1\otimes m_{N_1,N_2})\circ\alpha^{\mathcal C}_{QJM,QN_1,QN_2}.$$
Postcompose with $Q((\alpha^{\mathcal D}_{JM,N_1,N_2})^{-1})$ and precompose with $((v_M\otimes1)\otimes1)$. Functoriality cancels the inverse associators, giving equality of the expressions for $T(L)$ and $T(R)$ in Steps 3 and 4. Injectivity of the Hom bijection in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] proves the first displayed equation of the item, with precisely its specified source and target.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
For the counit equation write $Z=QF\otimes QN$ and transpose into $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(Z,Q(F\otimes N))$. Precomposition naturality of $T$ and its unit formula give
$$T\bigl(e_{F\otimes N}\circ J(m_{F,N})\bigr)
=Q(e_{F\otimes N})\circ v_{Q(F\otimes N)}\circ m_{F,N}=m_{F,N}.$$
The last equality is the right triangle identity $Q(e_H)\circ v_{QH}=1_{QH}$ at $H=F\otimes N$, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection].

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; agent-written abstract transpose calculation (not an assertion stated by this tag)

proof.text:
For the other side, postcomposition naturality, the defining transpose of $\kappa_{QF,N}$, and tensorator naturality give
$$\begin{aligned}
T\bigl((e_F\otimes1_N)\circ\kappa_{QF,N}\bigr)
&=Q(e_F\otimes1_N)\circ m_{JQF,N}\circ(v_{QF}\otimes1)\\
&=m_{F,N}\circ((Q(e_F)\circ v_{QF})\otimes1)=m_{F,N}.
\end{aligned}$$
Here the naturality is exactly that of [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], tensor composition is [def-sfb-monoidal-category], and the final cancellation is the right triangle identity of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Comparing with Step 6 and using injectivity proves the counit equation. These substitutions require neither symmetry nor full faithfulness nor invertibility of $\kappa$.

lean.statement: theorem unitAdjunctTensorAction {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] [MonoidalCategory C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] [MonoidalCategory D] {J : C ⥤ D} {Q : D ⥤ C} (adj : J ⊣ Q) [Q.Monoidal] : (∀ {M M' : C} {N N' : D} (a : M ⟶ M') (h : N ⟶ N'), J.map (a ⊗ₘ Q.map h) ≫ ((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app M').app N' = ((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app M).app N ≫ (J.map a ⊗ₘ h)) ∧ (∀ (M : C) (N₁ N₂ : D), ((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app (M ⊗ Q.obj N₁)).app N₂ ≫ (((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app M).app N₁ ⊗ₘ 𝟙 N₂) = J.map ((α_ M (Q.obj N₁) (Q.obj N₂)).hom ≫ (𝟙 M ⊗ₘ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ Q N₁ N₂)) ≫ ((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app M).app (N₁ ⊗ N₂) ≫ (α_ (J.obj M) N₁ N₂).inv) ∧ (∀ (F N : D), J.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ Q F N) ≫ adj.counit.app (F ⊗ N) = ((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D) (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app (Q.obj F)).app N ≫ (adj.counit.app F ⊗ₘ 𝟙 N))
